editorial.name: Really Good Emails
editorial.descriptionZh: 邮件设计参考库，19,000+ 封真实营销邮件按 Popular / Behavioral / Inaugural / Promotional / Seasonal 等大类和一串细分场景（Abandoned Cart、Referral、Loyalty / Rewards）归档，另有 Templates 与付费的 RGE Studio。
editorial.takeawayZh: 按 Abandoned Cart 一类翻别人的邮件版式和文案
editorial.noteZh: 首屏大红报头 R 图标，导航挂 Inspiration、RGE Studio、Resources、Community、Pricing、Talk to Sales。主标题 Find really good emails. Build really good emails.，下面 Sign Up & Do Stuff 与 Explore RGE Studio's creative wonders 两个按钮，再一行小字 Join more than 300,000 email makers who use RGE every month。往下 Inspiration gallery 一排胶囊标签：Welcome emails、Newsletter emails、Abandoned Cart emails、Product Launch emails、Promotional emails、Event emails、Review emails，再下面是邮件截图卡，每张带标题和 Save Email 收藏按钮，如 Welcome to our House, come on in、Digging with data、INTERNET BRUNCH。页脚有 School、Feedback Friday、Email signature generator，以及 Salesforce Marketing Cloud 与 Pardot 的集成入口。

reasons.statement: 交付物是 19,000+ 封真实邮件截图加可保存的参考，用户动作是翻看、收藏、按场景找同类，属营销创意案例集合。
分类轴是营销场景而非行业或技术（/categories/abandoned-cart、/referral、/loyalty-rewards），印证它为创意案例库。
站上另有 RGE Studio 与 Templates 收费层，但首屏主体仍是免费浏览的图库，故主类按图库判定。
